data.text:
Apps (public preview), Managed Agents (public preview), Workflows (GA) are available on Mistral Cloud today, and reach private cloud and on-premises deployments at the end of November.

📖 Learn more: https://t.co/hXLZ29VyJC

Our Applied AI team builds critical customer solutions on Studio, from penetration testing to KYC onboarding.

Customers can run both models and platform in their own environment, keeping sensitive data and specialist knowledge under their control.
